endpoints.note: Datamotive (Sulu) NL automotive SaaS. /sitemap.xml is a sitemapindex pointing to sitemaps/vehicle-N.xml (flat lists of vehicle detail URLs) + pages-1.xml. detail_url_re keeps only the /p/<slug>-<id> vehicle pages (optionally prefixed by /<brand>/<section>/) and drops the pages sitemap. Vehicle detail is static HTML with a single application/ld+json @graph whose Car node carries name/brand/VIN/mileageFromOdometer/modelDate + offers.price/priceCurrency. No JS/Playwright needed. Verified live 2026-06-10 on pouw.nl (extract_listing -> SEAT Arona VIN VSSZZZKJ0TR565306 33950 EUR).
